$comment: Derived from design-repo/ (templates/templates.json, sections/*.json, extraction/measured-values.json) — a separate, already-built and pushed N0 artifact at /Users/riyaghosh/V2 cloned/auxia/design-repo/. That repo documents 7 templates (it models /agent-studio and /decisioning as one 'product' template with variant conditions on 2 sections). This ia.json splits that template in two (template.product-agent-studio / template.product-decisioning) so every section's routeCount here is exact rather than approximated across a variant boundary — see the note on cta.band and case-studies.rail below. Route and section facts themselves are unchanged from the design-repo's measured evidence.

meta.source: Auxia — React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v3 rebuild of a Webflow marketing site. All 8 named routes plus the wildcard '*' are declared in src/App.jsx's single <Routes> block, wrapped in one shared Shell (Banner + Navbar + ...routes... + Footer) with no pathname-based conditionals in any of the three chrome components.
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, cross-checked against design-repo/registry.manifest.json and design-repo/extraction/measured-values.json

categories.SHELL: Chrome present identically on all 9 routes: announcement banner, primary nav, and footer, rendered once by the shared Shell wrapper in src/App.jsx regardless of page.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block establishing that page's core value proposition; always the first content section after shell chrome.
categories.PROOF: Social and customer proof: logo strip, customer case-study rail, and trust/compliance pillars.
categories.PRODUCT: Product-explanation and capability modules: problem/solution framing, the product stack, workflow diagrams, feature rows, use-case grids, and scale/automation statements.
categories.ABOUT: About-page-only narrative blocks: mission statement, company values, hiring cross-sell.
categories.CONTENT: Blog and legal long-form content: featured post spotlight, filterable post grid, legal document layout.
categories.CONVERSION: Conversion asks: closing CTA band, sibling-product cross-sell, demo-request form.
categories.UTILITY: Fallback content for any route that matches nothing else.

shell.banner.description: Top-of-page announcement bar driving awareness of a new launch. Text + link only, no motion.
shell.banner.scope: Present identically on all 9 routes (all 8 named routes plus the wildcard 404) — rendered once by the shared Shell wrapper, first element on every page.

shell.navbar.description: Primary site navigation and brand mark: up to 3 nav links and up to 2 product links. Position:relative, constant height, never sticky.
shell.navbar.scope: Present identically on all 9 routes — verified no useLocation/pathname conditional in Navbar.jsx itself; App.jsx's own doc comment naming only 4 routes is stale.

shell.footer.description: Closing site chrome: oversized self wordmark, up to 3 link columns, legal line. All outbound links point at '#' rather than real external destinations.
shell.footer.scope: Present identically on all 9 routes as the final element of the shared Shell.

hero.marketing.description: Homepage hero: the 1:1 personalization pitch headline plus an animated workflow/audience visual (desktop) or a horizontally-scrolling card row (mobile, a structural swap not a resize).
hero.marketing.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

hero.product.description: Product-page hero establishing the specific product's value prop. Two content variants sharing one contract: 'agent-studio' (prompts list, generated-UI visual) and 'decisioning' (users/tags, offers list, solid-blue ground, no dot field).
hero.product.scope: Present on both product routes (2 routes: /agent-studio and /decisioning), rendered by two distinct components under one section contract.

hero.about.description: About-page hero: mission statement over a dark (#191919) ground plus exactly 3 real headline stats.

brands.marquee.description: Social-proof logo strip, CSS infinite-scroll marquee (measured ~42.2px/sec). All 9 logos are original invented wordmarks standing in for real third-party marks — never a real company's logo.
brands.marquee.scope: Present on the homepage and both product pages (3 routes total): /, /agent-studio, /decisioning.

case-studies.rail.description: Customer proof: full-bleed horizontal rail of up to 8 case-study cards (a scrollable rail here, a real Splide carousel on the reference). Names/stats are Auxia's own published claims; logos are the same invented-wordmark set as brands.marquee.
case-studies.rail.scope: Present on the homepage and /agent-studio only (2 routes total) — confirmed absent from /decisioning.

trusted.grid.description: Trust/compliance pillars (SOC2, privacy, GDPR) — exactly 3 pillar cards over a dark ground with a GSAP-animated left-edge rule.
trusted.grid.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

marketing.split.description: Problem statement on a dark ground contrasting a messy vs. clean customer journey via two generated-UI diagrams (redrawn static content, not frame-by-frame animation).
marketing.split.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

stack.panels.description: The 3-layer product stack (Agent Studio / Decisioning / Data & Context) as three full-width stacked panels — explicitly not a 3-column grid.
stack.panels.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

process.flowchart.description: 6-step agent workflow as a literal vertical flowchart: SVG connector paths and tag pills between steps (1 opening prompt wrap + 5 real stage entries).
process.flowchart.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

automations.field.description: Scale statement: a live-decision counter over a dense, static 36-row field of automation names, revealed by pinned scroll-scrub — explicitly not an auto-scrolling marquee.
automations.field.scope: Present only on the homepage (1 route).

features.rows.description: Alternating image/copy feature rows (4-6 items) with an animated canvas connector between rows, closed by a 4-card enterprise-assurance block nested inside the last row's content.
features.rows.scope: Present on both product routes (2 routes: /agent-studio and /decisioning).

use-case.grid.description: Use-case card grid, column count and card count vary by product: 3 columns / 6 cards on /agent-studio, 4 columns / 4 cards on /decisioning.
use-case.grid.scope: Present on both product routes (2 routes), with differing cols/card-count per route.

about.market.description: Mission statement over a blue brand-surface ground with a real team photo.

about.values.description: Company values, exactly 5 entries, presented as a zig-zag threaded list on desktop (a static SVG zig-zag line, scroll-drawn) that collapses to a plain column below 992px.

about.team.description: Hiring/careers cross-sell closing the about page — the only template where the last content section is not a cta.band/prefooter; site-wide shell.footer still follows it.

blog.featured.description: Featured post spotlight rendered above the filterable listing; always the first content section on the blog index.

blog.list.description: Filterable/searchable card grid of blog posts with pagination control. Filtering is local-state only, no network request; responsive 3/2/1-column grid.

legal.prose.description: Long-form legal document layout: sticky TOC rail + rich-text column, identical shape between the two legal pages. Body prose is representative placeholder text; a visible role="note" warning banner disclosing this is required and confirmed rendered on both pages.
legal.prose.scope: Present on both legal routes (2 routes: /privacy-policy and /terms), sharing an identical layout shell.

cta.band.description: Closing full-width conversion band with a live dot-field canvas backdrop, heading and primary/secondary CTA.
cta.band.scope: Present on the homepage, /blog, and /agent-studio (3 routes total) — absent on /decisioning, whose prefooter.crosssell closes that page instead.

prefooter.crosssell.description: Cross-sells the sibling product before the footer. On /decisioning this is the last content section before shell.footer; on /agent-studio a cta.band follows it instead.
prefooter.crosssell.scope: Present on both product routes (2 routes: /agent-studio and /decisioning).

demo.form.description: Demo-request lead form: copy rail plus a local-state-only form. Performs zero network requests — the real reference posts to HubSpot and mounts a Cloudflare Turnstile widget, neither reproduced here.

utility.not-found.description: 404 fallback for any unmatched route: heading, body copy, and a link back to home.
utility.not-found.scope: Present only on the wildcard '*' route (1 route).
